title: Two universes: arithmetic vs harmonic analysis
summary: Langlands as a dictionary translating hard problems between number theory (integer solutions, modular arithmetic) and harmonic analysis (spectra of vibrating shapes).

title: Periodicity emerges at infinity
summary: Summing polynomial pieces yields a limiting periodic wave; analogy for primes looking random individually but revealing hidden symmetry when assembled.

title: Weil Rosetta stone analogy
summary: Three-column translation culture: number fields, finite fields/geometry of polynomials, complex geometry; integers vs polynomials as coefficient sequences.

title: Dictionary as problem-solving machine
summary: Each proved dictionary entry can improve analytic bounds stepwise; full functoriality still largely conjectural.

title: 1967 letter to Weil
summary: Langlands sends Weil a long speculative letter; becomes multi-decade research map; Abel 2018 for the program.

title: Geometric advances and open questions
summary: Popular claim of major geometric Langlands progress ~2024; arithmetic program largely open; 'why dictionary exists' remains deep.
